messages:
lena_ops: Heads-up: incoming H100 shipment from VendorX arrived at AMS crossdock but kitting failed — BOL missing serial manifest, customs flagged tariff mismatch. 18 units flagged DOA/damaged. AWB: 123-45678901. Need RMA guidance + ETA on replacements. Any insurance cover? cc @mike_vendor

mike_vendor: Sorry, looking now. Carrier notes 'broke pallet' in POD. We can issue RMA for the 18 DOA; need serials from your end to match returns. We'll open claim with our insurer (Policy #VX-2024-7). Carrier investigation typically 3–5 business days. We can expedite replacements via air at premium freight — approx +18% surcharge on freight or we can absorb some cost if needed. What's your preferred path?

lena_ops: We need replacements onsite within 7 business days. If vendor wants premium, ask for credit against our Q4 reserved commit. Also need provisional serials to stage. Sarah, can you hold 20 units in reserve from the EU pool?

sarah_planning: I can hold 20 from the EU pool but that reduces planned capacity for batch-42. If vendor covers expedite surcharge we can keep commit. If vendor doesn't cover, propose split: 10 expedited, 10 standard ship. Expedited ETA ~4 business days, standard ~14 business days.

chris_logistics: Customs already flagged HS code for H100 vs H200 — need corrected BOL and commercial invoice with SKU/serial mapping or customs will hold. Also need proper BOL number, otherwise crossdock can't process kitting.

mike_vendor: Sending corrected commercial invoice and corrected BOL now. Pasting provisional manifest below. We'll include serials and attempt to absorb expedite for first 10 units and offer 10% credit on invoice value for the damaged units. Claim with insurer initiated, claim ref IC-5567.

mike_vendor: ```
Manifest (provisional)
Qty: 18 H100 Units
Serials: H100-EU-00123,H100-EU-00124,H100-EU-00125,H100-EU-00126,H100-EU-00127,H100-EU-00128,H100-EU-00129,H100-EU-00130,H100-EU-00131,H100-EU-00132,H100-EU-00133,H100-EU-00134,H100-EU-00135,H100-EU-00136,H100-EU-00137,H100-EU-00138,H100-EU-00139,H100-EU-00140
BOL: BOL-VX-77821
Invoice: INV-VX-9921
Policy: VX-2024-7
```

raj_ops: For RMA flow: please use https://redwood.internal/rma — include root_cause: "transit damage" and set priority=expedite for the 10 units we agreed to rush. I'll approve immediate replacement allocation from EU reserve once RMA ticket is created.

nina_finance: We need a formal vendor adjustment note for accounting. Vendor credit memo ref CX-8891 — confirm amount and GL codes. If vendor pays expedite freight, characterize as freight expense reimbursement versus reduction to product revenue.

mike_vendor: Credit memo drafted CX-8891 amount EUR 14,400 (10% credit on damaged units). AWB for replacements updated: 123-45678901 -> 123-45678902 (replacements). Expedited ETA: 2024-08-18 for the 10 units. Standard replacements ETA: 2024-08-28. Insurer claim IC-5567 in progress. Vendor approves customs broker fee for reclassification up to EUR 350.

lena_ops: :thumbsup: Good. Chris — once BOL/invoice updated ping customs broker to release hold. Raj — block 20 units for hold. I'll create RMA entries with serials now.

rma_bot: RMA created: RMA-2024-7853 for 18 units, status: pending_inspection. RMA-2024-7854 for 10 expedited replacements, status: allocated.

chris_logistics: Customs broker acknowledged updated docs and lifted provisional hold; expedited shipments cleared for air. Broker fee estimate EUR 320 for reclassification — vendor approved per message. Please confirm routing: ship replacements to AMS crossdock for kitting or direct to FR DC?

mike_vendor: Confirm sending replacements to AMS crossdock (per request) for kitting. We'll provide AWB/tracking once tendered (new AWB 123-45678902). We'll also provide insurer contact and claim packet.

sarah_planning: Confirmed: route to AMS crossdock so ops can kitting and reassign to FR after QA. I'll mark batch-42 capacity impacted and update rollout plan (possible 8% latency on downstream jobs).

lena_ops: Thanks all — I'll update the incident ticket with RMA numbers and procurement credit memo refs, and follow up once replacements land. Closing loop for now.
